valid.title: S-A: reefer failure, rule-decided re-route, dual approval
valid.description: A compressor fault on Sierra Cold Freight's trailer warms a tier-A organic lot. Detection opens the case unprompted; the engine scores five options against doing nothing; a rule decides the re-route to Bayline (no AI). Policy v1 requires Sales and Quality; the gateway then writes to SAP, the TMS and the carrier. Numbers are the design's illustrative worked example.

analyst.question: Which lots have less than 10 days of shelf life left?

answer.question: Which lots have less than 10 days of shelf life left?
answer.interpretation: Lots whose remaining shelf life, as of their last reading, is below 10 days.
answer.sql: SELECT * FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(BBC_OS.SEM.EXCURSION_RECOVERY DIMENSIONS lots.lot_id, products.variety METRICS lot_thermal.remaining_shelf_life_days) WHERE remaining_shelf_life_days < 10 ORDER BY remaining_shelf_life_days
